description: Here, we the our team is going to present a story about the unique and not found pieces left at the Moon and Mars. This story is going to be super interesting and even us as a team are going to gain lots and lots of knowledge!
summary: we made a storyline about the oppurtunity rover left on mars. we hope that our story helps create more awareness about the rover and explains its entire story very well!
details:
* The 15-Year Marathon. Traces Oppy’s historic trek across Martian craters using official NASA traverse maps.

* Martian Superpowers. Breaks down Oppy’s engineering—such as its Solar Power Wings, Panoramic Cameras (Pancam), Robotic Arm, and Rock Abrasion Tool (RAT)—in simple, kid-friendly language.

* Groundbreaking Water Discoveries. Showcases real NASA imagery of Martian "blueberries" (hematite spheres), ancient water ripples, gypsum veins, and meteorites that proved Mars once had liquid water.

* Surviving Martian Dangers & The Final Goodbye. Shares the dramatic stories of escaping the 2005 Purgatory Dune sand trap, getting cleaned by passing dust devils, and sending its famous final transmission ("My battery is low and it's getting dark") during the 2018 global dust storm before resting in Perseverance Valley. How We Built It

We researched official NASA Mars Exploration Rover (MER) mission archives, high-resolution surface panoramas, and spacecraft schematics, then structured them into a visual narrative deck using Microsoft PowerPoint and OneDrive cloud sharing so educators and students anywhere can explore Oppy’s legacy.
